# Slate Star Codex

> > Rationalist blog exploring philosophy, medicine, policy, and culture through rigorous analysis and contrarian thinking

Slate Star Codex is a highly influential rationalist blog written by psychiatrist Scott Alexander, covering topics from epistemology and cognitive biases to policy analysis and book reviews. The blog is closely connected to the Less Wrong community, effective altruism movement, and features regular open threads for community discussion.

## Key Topics

- Rationality and epistemology
- Effective Altruism
- Less Wrong community
- Policy analysis
- Philosophy of science
- Cognitive biases
- Medical ethics and psychiatry
- Culture war dynamics
- Book reviews
- Media criticism
- Bioethics and genetics
- Statistical methodology
- Government programs and welfare policy
- Discourse and argumentation
- Community discussion (open threads)

## Philosophy and Rationality

- [The Toxoplasma Of Rage](https://slatestarcodex.com/2014/12/17/the-toxoplasma-of-rage): Viral outrage analysis examining culture war memetics and controversy
- [Does Race Exist? Does Culture?](https://slatestarcodex.com/2014/08/12/does-race-exist-does-culture): Philosophy of science examining ontology of race and cultural categories
- [On Overconfidence](https://slatestarcodex.com/2015/08/20/on-overconfidence): Rationality essay on cognitive bias and epistemological self-assessment
- [Fake Consensualism](https://slatestarcodex.com/2013/08/25/fake-consensualism): Philosophy post on epistemology, argumentation, and consensus-building
- [The Virtue of Silence](https://slatestarcodex.com/2013/06/14/the-virtue-of-silence): Philosophy post on rationality, communication, and discourse strategy

## Book Reviews and Media Criticism

- [Book Review: Manufacturing Consent](https://slatestarcodex.com/2015/09/11/book-review-manufacturing-consent): Review of Manufacturing Consent analyzing media and propaganda models
- [Lies, Damned Lies, And Facebook (Part 2 of ∞)](https://slatestarcodex.com/2013/04/04/lies-damned-lies-and-facebook-part-2-of-%e2%88%9e): Social media criticism examining Facebook statistics and misinformation

## Policy Analysis and Social Issues

- [Drug Testing Welfare Users Is A Sham, But Not For The Reasons You Think](https://slatestarcodex.com/2015/02/14/drug-testing-welfare-users-is-a-sham-but-not-for-the-reasons-you-think): Policy analysis critiquing drug testing programs for welfare recipients

## Medicine and Science

- [Do You Believe Me, Doc?](https://slatestarcodex.com/2014/04/16/do-you-believe-me-doc): Explores medical trust and patient credibility in doctor-patient dynamics
- [That Chocolate Study](https://slatestarcodex.com/2015/05/30/that-chocolate-study): Critique of chocolate research methodology and scientific quality issues
- [Genetic Russian Roulette](https://slatestarcodex.com/2013/11/19/genetic-russian-roulette): Analysis of genetic risk, inheritance probability, and bioethics

## Community Discussion

- [OT24: Hopen Change](https://slatestarcodex.com/2015/07/19/ot24-hopen-change): Open thread #24 for community discussion and blogroll updates
- [OT18: Istanbul, Not Constantinopen](https://slatestarcodex.com/2015/04/13/ot18-istanbul-not-constantinopen): Open thread #18 for rationality community discussion
- [Open Thread 7: The Hunt For Thread October](https://slatestarcodex.com/2014/10/28/open-thread-7-the-hunt-for-thread-october): Open thread #7 for October 2014 community discussion
